entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What do we do about that[n]cheater? Ain't we screwed if[n]our attacks can't do anything?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He is invincible at his[n]game, so he is invincible[n]in Mementos as well...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then how about we just beat[n]him at that game of his? Oh,[n]but he'll just cheat...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: How 'bout we ask for help[n]from a skilled player?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Supposedly there's an insanely[n]good gamer they call the "King"[n]somewhere in this city.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I've seen all over the forums how[n]he managed to beat this cheater[n]himself with orthodox methods.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!? Where can we find him?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I checked his account[n]from the official server...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But I couldn't pinpoint what[n]arcade he goes to. Sorry...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But if he's really that famous,[n]won't it be easy to find him?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's true. OK, we should[n]gather intel on the King at[n]the arcades around the city.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I didn't know someone could get famous[n]just by being good at a video game...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In any case, we might be able to complete[n]the request if we can find this "King."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: With his help... we'll crush that cheating[n]jerk for sure!
